title: Pukka Juice 5000+ Raspberry Pomegranate 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pukka Juice 5000+ Raspberry Pomegranate Nic Salt e-liquid delivers a delicious fusion of ripe, tangy Raspberry and sweet, exotic Pomegranate. The combination of bright, tart berry notes with the deep, juicy flavour of Pomegranate creates a well-balanced, refreshing vape that’s bursting with fruity goodness. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, Pukka Juice 5000+ Nic Salts are designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) vape kits and pod systems. The e-liquid provides smooth throat hits and fast nicotine relief, making it an excellent option for those looking for a satisfying alternative to traditional tobacco products. Available in both 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Raspberry Pomegranate offers an all-day vape with a sweet and tangy edge. Pukka Juice are an award-winning UK brand celebrated for their bold and vibrant e-liquid flavours. The Pukka Juice 5000+ collection captures the intense flavours vapers love from disposable vapes in a more versatile format. Explore other flavours from the collection, such as Tropical, Berry Blast, and Lime Twist.
